# Enable Death Spectate All Players

Source: [wiki article 4379](../archive/4379.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Enable Death Spectate All Players](../../api/actions/enable-death-spectate-all-players.md).

<a id="wiki-4379-n1"></a>
